scientific_integrity: Analytical fixed-matrix asymptotics for independent real tensorized Gaussian norm-validation probes; no independent validation or publication priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real matrix and fixed positive number of independent factor-pair probes; all asymptotics are at diverging distortion.
Separable residual chosen independently of test sketches.
No uniform small-ball remainder as the spectrum collapses; no complex, adaptive, or two-sided fully crossed block-probe theorem.
Known scalar product-normal logarithmic behavior and the qualitative rank-two log removal are explicitly prior work.
title: Spectrally sharp small-ball constants for independent tensorized Gaussian probes
